[[Tateos]] crafts [[armor]] for [[core]] and [[Factions]] professions using the [[Luxon armor]] art. Tateos also crafts [[Elementalist headgear#Auras|Elementalist Auras]]. All armor is crafted with an empty [[insignia slot]].

Luxon armor requires the rare crafting material [[Jadeite Shard|Jadeite]].
